svg.title: Engagement board lettering
svg.desc: Five editable vector lettering groups. The two source headings are traced directly from a.jpg. Replacement names and date use rounded handwritten-style outlines: Parisienne for Mr. Ning & Miss. Wu; STXingkai (华文行楷) for 宁忠瑞、吴南 and 丙午年八月廿五. The original font cannot be confirmed from the raster reference.

g.data-font: Parisienne (Google Fonts; closest visual match, original not confirmed)
